items.headline: U.S. Futures Mixed as Investors Eye Key Inflation Data and Nvidia Earnings
items.summary: U.S. stock futures showed mixed movements this morning as markets brace for the release of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index for July and highly anticipated Q2 earnings from semiconductor giant Nvidia ($NVDA) after the close. Oil prices continued their recent decline, easing concerns over geopolitical tensions. Yesterday, major indices closed higher, driven by a technology rebound and falling Treasury yields. Not financial advice.

items.headline: DICK'S Sporting Goods Plunges on Disappointing Results
items.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods experienced its worst session on record since 2002 following the release of disappointing financial results.

items.headline: Nvidia Rebounds Ahead of Earnings
items.summary: Nvidia snapped a seven-day losing streak, closing higher as investors positioned themselves ahead of its Q2 earnings report.

items.headline: APA Corp Among Energy Sector Losers
items.summary: The energy sector lagged as oil prices fell amid hopes of eased Mideast tensions. APA Corp was a significant decliner.

items.headline: July PCE Price Index Released Today
items.summary: The July Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, is slated for release this morning. Economists anticipate a modest 0.1% month-over-month increase and a 3.6% year-over-year rise in prices.

items.headline: Nvidia Earnings Eyed After Market Close
items.summary: Nvidia ($NVDA) is scheduled to report its second-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings after the U.S. market closes today. Analysts project earnings of $2.09 per share on $92.2 billion in revenue, with market focus keenly on future guidance for the AI sector.

items.headline: Kohl's Reports Q2 Results, Raises Outlook
items.summary: Kohl's Corporation ($KSS) today announced its second-quarter fiscal 2026 financial results, reporting a 0.9% decrease in net sales and comparable sales. The company posted diluted earnings per share of $1.28 and raised its full-year 2026 financial outlook while restarting its share repurchase program.

items.headline: Jackson Hole Symposium Looms for Fed Insights
items.summary: All eyes are turning to Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium on Friday. Investors will be seeking clues regarding the future trajectory of the Fed's monetary policy, especially after the Fed maintained its rate in the 3.5-3.75% range at its last meeting.

items.headline: Oil Prices Continue Descent Amid Easing Tensions
items.summary: Crude oil prices extended their decline today, with Brent crude dropping below $87 a barrel. The continued fall is attributed to easing concerns over broader military conflicts and ongoing discussions between Oman and Iran aimed at ensuring the safe passage of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: Tech Leads, Energy Lags in Tuesday's Trading
items.summary: On Tuesday, the Information Technology sector was the top performer, gaining 0.98%, driven by a surge in AI-related stocks. Conversely, the Energy sector was the worst performer, declining 1.70%, due to falling oil prices.
